payout_value_note: Tiered: $50 per referral who opens personal checking/savings, $100 per business referral, $150 when the new customer opens both personal and business same-day. No limit on qualified referrals.
payout_quote: Current customers with eligible checking or savings accounts can earn $50, $100, or $150 for each new customer you refer to SouthEast Bank. Once your referral meets these qualifications, both of you earn the following rewards
numeric_basis: payout tiers from official southeastbank.com/refer page ('earn $50, $100, or $150 for each new customer you refer'); time: registering and sharing referral est. 5-15 min active
eligibility: Current SouthEast Bank customers with an eligible checking or savings account; referred friend must be a new customer opening an eligible account (personal and/or business).
steps: Be a current SouthEast Bank customer with an eligible checking or savings account
Register for the Refer a Friend program and get your referral link
Share the referral link with friends/businesses
Friend opens an eligible personal checking/savings account and enrolls in eStatements, and completes a direct deposit of at least $500 or 10 debit card purchases within 60 days ($50 tier)
Or friend opens an eligible business checking/savings account, enrolls in eStatements, and completes an ACH or EFT of at least $1000 within 60 days ($100 tier)
Or friend opens both personal and business same-day and meets both sets of requirements ($150 tier)
Once your referral meets the qualifications, both of you earn the reward
